description: Source code implementing server-side SRP (Secure Remote Password) protocol functions, including server initialization, key generation, key retrieval, verification, and cleanup.

methods.name: t_serveropenraw
methods.description: Initializes a server session with user credentials and cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: t_servergenexp
methods.description: Generates a server ephemeral public value for SRP protocol.

methods.name: t_servergetkey
methods.description: Computes the session key based on client input and server state.

methods.name: t_serververify
methods.description: Verifies the client's response against expected values for authentication.

methods.name: t_serverresponse
methods.description: Returns the server's session response data.

methods.name: t_serverclose
methods.description: Cleans up and frees server session resources.
